# AppSync

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/appsync@v1.62.4` · last audited 2026-10-12 (`0c1472972`)

### Known gaps

- StartDataSourceIntrospection against PostgreSQL and MySQL: the information_schema/pg_index catalog queries are verified only against a fake executor, not a live engine of either kind; only the SQLite path runs end to end.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- Cognito/OIDC issuers with no local signing key are rejected because external JWKS endpoints are never fetched (no external network).

### Deferred

- CloudTrail-capture chokepoint / pkgs/service integration — not audited (shared/cross-service, out of scope per this task's edit boundary).
